final: WITH groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as count FROM Employee WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ReportsTo), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM groups), with_shares AS (SELECT g.ReportsTo, g.count, g.count * 1.0 / t.total as share, 1.0 / t.num_groups as avg_share, g.count * 1.0 / t.total - 1.0 / t.num_groups as diff FROM groups g, totals t) SELECT ReportsTo, count, share, diff FROM with_shares ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
